title: Microscopic Origin of the Shannon Renyi Boundary Phase in the Critical Ising Chain
summary: Shannon--Rényi entropies probe the full measurement distribution of a quantum many-body state, but their microscopic evaluation remains difficult even in free-fermion systems. We show that the Born distribution of the critical transverse-field Ising chain is exactly the parity boundary of a weak inverse-square classical Ising model, a structure revealed by the Cauchy form of its probability kernel.
